national_news.title: PM Modi Inaugurates RBI Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute in Odisha
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the RBI's Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute at Info Valley-II in Jatni, near Bhubaneswar, Odisha.
The project is built at an estimated cost of around 170 crore rupees to strengthen critical financial data security and digital infrastructure.
The Cybersecurity Training Institute will focus on research and specialized training in enterprise computing, AI, quantum computing, and cybersecurity.

national_news.title: SEBI Chairman Highlights Retail Broking Growth and Investor Awareness at ANMI Convention
bullets: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey stated at the ANMI convention that the next wave of retail broking will originate from smaller towns and villages.
SEBI's 'Samajh Se Investing Simple' campaign has garnered over 15 crore views and 110 crore WhatsApp messages since October 5.
India's equity market capitalization stands at approximately 470 lakh crore rupees, with Mutual Fund AUM at around 83 lakh crore rupees.

national_news.title: EAM Dr S Jaishankar Emphasizes Dialogue, Diplomacy, and Multilateralism at Global Forum
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar stated at the Chinmaya Amrit Mahotsav Global Sammelan in New Delhi that dialogue and diplomacy are the only solutions to global conflicts like Ukraine and West Asia.
He highlighted that terrorism is a deadly threat to peace, noting that its use as an instrument of statecraft is unacceptable and requires zero tolerance from all states.

Addressing economic disparities, he noted that the Global South faces a 4F crisis (finance, fuel, food, and fertilizer) and advocated for an inclusive, human-centric approach to emerging technologies like AI.

national_news.title: India Exposes Pakistan's Minority Rights Violations and Military Control at UN
bullets: India strongly criticized Pakistan at the UN General Assembly’s Third Committee during an interactive dialogue with the Special Rapporteur on Minority Issues.
First Secretary to the UN Raghoo Puri called Pakistan's administration a 'Form 47 government' and highlighted that the country's military exercises decisive control over its political leadership.
India reiterated that Jammu and Kashmir is an integral part of the country and demanded the vacation of territories under Pakistan's illegal occupation.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi Marks 12 Years of Mann Ki Baat, Highlights Grassroots Initiatives
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the nation on Akashvani marking 12 years of the 'Mann Ki Baat' radio broadcast, which began on Vijayadashami.

He highlighted grassroots initiatives including Punjab's 'Kheti Virasat Mission' promoting organic cotton ('Nav-Trinjan'), the revitalization of the Heval river in Tehri Garhwal, and Maharashtra tribes' 'Shabari Naturals' winning Japan's Good Design Award.
The PM noted that 'Vocal for Local' is expanding global markets for Indian produce, citing Purnia's Makhana reaching Greece and Kalaburagi's Arhar Dal being exported to the Maldives.

national_news.title: Centre Achieves Target of Creating 11 Crore Farmer IDs Ahead of Schedule
bullets: The Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare successfully created 11 crore Farmer IDs across the country, achieving the target ahead of the March 2027 deadline.
The initiative is implemented under the Digital Agriculture Mission, which received Union Cabinet approval on September 2, 2024.
The unique digital identity provides farmers transparent access to government schemes, bank credit, crop insurance, and disaster relief while eliminating duplicate verification and fraud.

national_news.title: India Records Best-Ever Performance with 114 Medals at Asian Para Games 2026
bullets: Indian para-athletes achieved a historic, best-ever performance by securing a record 114 medals at the Asian Para Games 2026.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi lauded the contingent, emphasizing the exceptional determination and inspiration provided by each athlete to the nation.
The stellar medal tally marks a monumental milestone in India's growing stature in international para-sports.

national_news.title: DGHS Issues Warning Against Reuse of Single-Use Medical Devices
bullets: The Director General of Health Services (DGHS) cautioned public and private healthcare facilities against reusing single-use medical devices and disposable surgical items.
The practice is frequently observed in critical specialties like Cardiology, Nephrology, Oncology, Neurosurgery, and Cardiothoracic Surgery.
Reusing such items poses severe health risks, including cross-infection, device malfunction, procedure complications, and compromises patient safety.

national_news.title: India Chem 2026 Concludes in Mumbai Highlighting Global Chemical Hub Status
bullets: The 14th edition of India Chem 2026 was held in Mumbai with the theme 'Advantage Bharat : An Emerging Global Chemicals Hub'.
The event was jointly organized by the Department of Chemicals & Petrochemicals and FICCI, with Japan as the official partner country.
Roundtable discussions and forums focused on specialty chemicals, agrochemicals, infrastructure, and international trade collaborations with Japan, the US, and the EU.

national_news.title: Government to Bear Entire Cost of Certification for MSMEs under Export Promotion Mission
bullets: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal announced that the government will bear the entire cost of expensive certifications for micro and small enterprises under the Export Promotion Mission (EPM).
The EPM has a total outlay of Rs 25,060 crore over six financial years, implemented through two sub-schemes: Niryat Protsahan (Rs 10,401 crore) and Niryat Disha (Rs 14,659 crore).
The support aims to help Indian businesses access global markets and comply with European Union requirements such as the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism and EU Deforestation Regulation.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman Chairs 30th FSDC Meeting
bullets: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman chaired the 30th meeting of the Financial Stability and Development Council (FSDC) in New Delhi.
The council reviewed the 'Your Money, Your Right' campaign to expedite the refund of unclaimed assets like bank deposits, shares, and insurance proceeds to their rightful owners.
The meeting deliberated on simplifying KYC procedures, enhancing cybersecurity preparedness, fintech innovation, and tokenisation of financial assets.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Addresses Army Commanders' Conference, Releases Land Warfare Doctrine
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed the Army Commanders' Conference in New Delhi, emphasizing a 20 to 30-year long-term strategic vision for future warfare.
Released the new Land Warfare Doctrine to provide an overarching framework for future conflicts and multi-domain capabilities.
Highlighted that domestic defence production reached Rs 1.78 lakh crore and defence exports touched an all-time high of around Rs 38,000 crore in FY 2025-26.

national_news.title: India Emerges as Third-Largest Arms Exporter to Europe
bullets: India has emerged as the third-largest arms exporter to Europe, supported by the EU's 'ReArm Europe' initiative and domestic manufacturing growth.
Total defence exports reached an all-time high of Rs 38,424 crore (approx. 3.6 billion euros), supplying equipment to over 80 countries.
The government aims to allocate 75% of annual defence capital expenditure to domestic products under the Make in India initiative.

national_news.title: 19th Urban Mobility India Conference and Exhibition 2026 Inaugurated in Bhubaneswar
bullets: The 19th Urban Mobility India (UMI) Conference and Exhibition 2026 was inaugurated in Bhubaneswar by Union Minister of State for Housing and Urban Affairs Tokhan Sahu.

The event is organized by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) through the Institute of Urban Transport (India) with support from the Government of Odisha, focusing on the theme 'Urban Accessibility and Liveability in Digital Age'.
India's operational metro network has expanded significantly from 248 km in 2014 to over 1,185 km across 26 cities, with another 998 km under construction.

national_news.title: MoS Pabitra Margherita Visits Samoa and Nauru to Strengthen Bilateral Ties
bullets: Minister of State for External Affairs Pabitra Margherita undertook an official visit to Samoa and Nauru from October 16 to 22, 2026, to bolster cooperation under the Forum for India-Pacific Islands Cooperation (FIPIC) framework.
An MoU on the implementation of the SENESE Project was signed in Samoa to promote the inclusion and development of children and persons with disabilities.
Engagements in Nauru featured the flagging off of a mini-cycling event under India's Quick Impact Project (QIP) titled 'Cycling for a Stronger Nauru' and interactions with ITEC and ICCR alumni.

national_news.title: Strategic Communication Key to Sustainable Mass Transit: UMI Conference
bullets: A roundtable on 'Behaviour Change and Public Communication' was chaired by PIB ADG Akhil Kumar Mishra on the sidelines of the 19th UMI Conference in Bhubaneswar.
Experts emphasized integrating strategic public communication and behavioral interventions into urban transport planning to reduce private vehicle dependence.
The panel highlighted the need to eliminate 'information shadows' in slums and peripheral areas through hyper-local communication strategies.

national_news.title: Centre Launches AATAL Facility for Real-Time Air Pollution Analysis in Delhi-NCR
bullets: Union Minister Jitendra Singh inaugurated the Integrated Atmospheric Chemistry and Aerosol Toxicity Analysis Laboratory (AATAL) at the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology's (IITM) Delhi branch.
Established under 'Mission Mausam' by the Ministry of Earth Sciences, AATAL is billed as the world's first-of-its-kind integrated air pollution analysis facility.
The facility integrates with IITM's AIRWISE system to provide 72-hour air-quality forecasts at a spatial resolution of 400 metres to aid bodies like the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM).

national_news.title: Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Framework Rolled Out
bullets: The Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) (VB-G RAM G) Act, 2025 came into force on 1 July 2026, succeeding Mahatma Gandhi NREGA.
The Act provides a statutory guarantee of 125 days of wage employment every financial year for every rural household volunteering for unskilled manual work.
It focuses on four thematic areas: water security, core rural infrastructure, livelihood-related infrastructure, and mitigation of extreme weather events using Viksit Gram Panchayat Plans (VGPPs).

bihar_news.title: Bihar Sets Rs 4.95 Lakh Crore Annual Credit Target for 2026-27
bullets: Bihar set an Annual Credit Plan target of Rs 4.95 lakh crore for the financial year 2026-27, focusing on agriculture, MSMEs, startups, and priority sectors.
The directives were issued during the third review meeting chaired by Development Commissioner Mihir Kumar Singh.
A new 100-point scientific measurement index was introduced to assess and rank the performance of banks operating in the state.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Develop Rs 16,500-Crore Manufacturing City in Gayaji
bullets: Bihar government unveiled the logo and portal for a 1,670-acre manufacturing city in Dobhi block of Gaya (Gayaji) under the Amritsar-Kolkata Industrial Corridor (AKIC).
The project carries an estimated investment potential of Rs 16,500 crore and aims to generate over 1.1 lakh jobs.
MoUs with 12 industrial units worth Rs 4,092 crore were signed across sectors like energy, textiles, automobiles, and agro-processing, and Bihar Business Connect 2027 was announced for February.

bihar_news.title: Piped Natural Gas (PNG) Service Launched in Buxar's Dumraon, Bihar
bullets: Piped Natural Gas (PNG) service has been inaugurated in the Textile Colony of Dumraon in Buxar district, Bihar, by District Magistrate Sahila Heer.
Implemented by Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL), a total of 498 technically feasible households have been provided with initial PNG connections.
The initiative eliminates the hassle of booking and transporting traditional LPG cylinders, offering an uninterrupted, cost-effective, and direct supply of cooking gas.
